retailer_description"\"At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you're looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we've got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of cane sugar, ALOHA's protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day with no artificial ingredients or sugar alcohols. ALOHA's organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free (lactose-free), stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA Protein Bars are corn-free — our organic vegetable glycerin is derived from flax seed, not corn. ALOHA's organic, plant-based Chocolate Fudge Brownie protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic cocoa powder. The perfect protein bar for when you're between meetings, warming up for the gym (or cooling down!), on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar.\""

retailer_description"One step. Three acids. Results that build. Andalou's Resurfacing Triple Acid Exfoliating Toner is a milky, leave-on 5% AHA toner that addresses texture, pore appearance, and the look of dark spots all at once — because your skin deserves more than a single-acid solution. Powered by Fruit Science™, glycolic, lactic, and mandelic acids each do a different job: glycolic exfoliates at the surface, lactic smooths and supports hydration, mandelic gently addresses uneven tone. Niacinamide visibly refines pore appearance while pineapple and papaya enzymes lift dull surface buildup. The result is skin that looks smoother, more even-toned, and visibly refreshed — no rinsing required. Rooted in renewal and refined by science — at Andalou, our patented Fruit Science™ innovation is clinically proven to support skin's natural wisdom. We don't fight change. We formulate for it. Suitable for sensitive skin. Dermatologist tested. Begin 1–2 uses weekly, increasing to daily as tolerated. Sunburn Alert: This product contains alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs). Apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen daily while using this product and for one week after. AHAs may increase skin's sensitivity to sun exposure. Formulated without parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or other harmful additives. Cruelty free."

retailer_description"Bring a unique red wine to your table with 14 Hands Cabernet Sauvignon. A medium bodied, red wine with notes of black currants and juicy dark cherry is emboldened by a tantalizing undercurrent of spicy oak. Refined tannins emphasize the fruit-forward taste of the dry wine. Made in Washington state’s renowned Columbia Valley, this dry red wine is anything but boring. This delicious Cabernet Sauvignon wine pairs beautifully with appetizers, lamb, beef or red sauce pasta dishes. Add an adventurous flair to drinks with friends or to a quiet dinner when you pour a glass from this 14 Hands bottle of wine. Serve this red wine at room temperature and unleash the bold flavors within. Wine bottles are 750 ml and have a 13.5% ABV. 14 Hands is inspired by the unbridled spirit of the wild horses that once freely roamed eastern Washington. Like the untamed horses we honor with our name, our wild and wonderful wines pack a lot of character into each bottle."

retailer_description"Bring a unique, polished red wine to your table with 14 Hands Hot to Trot Smooth Red Blend. This dauntless red wine blend tempts right off the bat with aromas of bright cherry and succulent red currant. A medium bodied, slightly dry red wine with notes of berry and plum and a spicy finish is the perfect beginning to an unforgettable night. Flavors of cherry pie, ripe berries and plums give way to subtle notes of baking spice on a persistent finish. Hot to Trot Red Blend consists predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot and other varietals including Syrah, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, making it a deliciously complex bottle of wine. Made in Washington state’s renowned Columbia Valley, this red blend wine brings the spirit of the wild in each drop. This delicious red wine pairs beautifully with pork chops, grilled portabella mushrooms, gourmet cheeses and pasta dishes. Wine bottles are 750 ml and have a 13.5% ABV. Our wild and wonderful wines pack a lot of character into each bottle."

retailer_description"Jack & Annie’s Plant Based Buffalo Wings: Do you want to enjoy delicious meaty flavors without the health and environmental downsides? retailer_description"GIOVANNI's 2chic Ultra-Moist Conditioner is powered by our Dual Moisture Complex of Avocado and Olive Oil that helps to add significant moisture, strength and shine for healthier and more lustrous locks that you can style with confidence. This ultra moisturizing Conditioner silkens coarse hair with softness and shine. Look in the Ingredients section for a listing of *USDA certified organic ingredients.GIOVANNI was the first full-range, salon-inspired hair-care brand in natural product stores, and today is the #1 selling Hair Care line in the United States Natural Products Industry. But before there was a brand, there was a pioneer. Arthur Guidotti had a vision and a love for all things hair. He began developing his passion as a hairstylist in Hollywood and Beverly Hills. He worked for a time with hairstylist icon Gene Shacove and was good friends with “the father of hair color,” Al Lapin . By the 1960s, Arthur was maturing his talents and decided to open his own salon, called On Sunset. The salon was a bustling site, on the famous Sunset Strip, and a hit with many Hollywood celebrities, including Lucille Ball . Since 1979 the GIOVANNI Rule of Balance has been our commitment to make each product as pure and as natural as possible without sacrificing exceptional product performance. GIOVANNI is committed to creating only the highest-performance formulations, wrapped in aesthetically beautiful packaging and marketed with extraordinary visuals and graphics."

retailer_description"Bring a unique red wine to your table with 14 Hands Cabernet Sauvignon. A medium bodied, red wine with notes of black currants and juicy dark cherry is emboldened by a tantalizing undercurrent of spicy oak. Refined tannins emphasize the fruit-forward taste of the dry wine. Made in Washington state’s renowned Columbia Valley, this dry red wine is anything but boring. This delicious Cabernet Sauvignon wine pairs beautifully with appetizers, lamb, beef or red sauce pasta dishes. Add an adventurous flair to drinks with friends or to a quiet dinner when you pour a glass from this 14 Hands bottle of wine. Serve this red wine at room temperature and unleash the bold flavors within. Wine bottles are 750 ml and have a 13.5% ABV. 14 Hands is inspired by the unbridled spirit of the wild horses that once freely roamed eastern Washington. Like the untamed horses we honor with our name, our wild and wonderful wines pack a lot of character into each bottle."

A medium bodied, slightly dry red wine with notes of berry and plum and a spicy finish is the perfect beginning to an unforgettable night. Flavors of cherry pie, ripe berries and plums give way to subtle notes of baking spice on a persistent finish. Hot to Trot Red Blend consists predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot and other varietals including Syrah, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, making it a deliciously complex bottle of wine. Made in Washington state’s renowned Columbia Valley, this red blend wine brings the spirit of the wild in each drop. This delicious red wine pairs beautifully with pork chops, grilled portabella mushrooms, gourmet cheeses and pasta dishes. Wine bottles are 750 ml and have a 13.5% ABV. retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"\"At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you're looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we've got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of cane sugar, ALOHA's protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day with no artificial ingredients or sugar alcohols. ALOHA's organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free (lactose-free), stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA Protein Bars are corn-free — our organic vegetable glycerin is derived from flax seed, not corn. ALOHA's organic, plant-based Chocolate Fudge Brownie protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic cocoa powder. The perfect protein bar for when you're between meetings, warming up for the gym (or cooling down!), on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar.\""
retailer_ingredients"Peanuts*, Tapioca Fiber*, Protein Blend* (Brown Rice Protein*, Pumpkin Seed Protein*), Chocolate Chips* (Chocolate*, Cane Sugar*, Cocoa Butter*, Vanilla Extract*), Tapioca Syrup*, Vegetable Glycerin*, Roasted Pumpkin Seeds*, Sea Salt, Monk Fruit*. *Organic. Contains: Peanuts. Manufactured in a facility that also processes fish, milk, sesame, soy, tree nuts, and wheat."

So when you’re looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we’ve got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of natural sugar, ALOHA’s protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day without the dreaded sugar crash. ALOHA’s organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free lactose-free, stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks the all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA’s organic, plant-based Chocolate Mint protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic peppermint oil. The perfect protein bar for when you’re between meetings, warming up for the gym or cooling down, on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar."

retailer_description"Indulge in the authentic taste of Italy with Cento Certified San Marzano Whole Peeled Tomatoes, a culinary treasure that brings the rich flavors of Italian cuisine straight to your kitchen. Each 28 oz can in this pack of six is filled with the finest San Marzano tomatoes, renowned for their superior quality and taste. Grown in the fertile soils of Italy, these plum tomatoes are carefully harvested at the peak of ripeness to ensure a fresh, vibrant, unmatched flavor. Whether you're crafting a classic tomato basil sauce or enhancing your favorite Italian dishes, these whole peeled tomatoes are your go-to choice for an authentic taste experience. Centos San Marzano tomatoes are not just any canned tomatoes; they are a testament to quality and tradition. Packed in a thick, flavorful puree with a hint of basil, these tomatoes offer a perfect balance of sweetness and acidity, making them ideal for a variety of recipes. From hearty tomato sauces to comforting soups and stews, the possibilities are endless. Unlike ordinary canned tomatoes, Centos San Marzano tomatoes are certified and traceable, ensuring that you receive only the best tomatoes that Italy has to offer. Their robust flavor and firm texture make them a favorite among chefs and home cooks alike. Elevate your culinary creations with the unparalleled taste of Cento Certified San Marzano Whole Peeled Tomatoes. These canned tomatoes are a staple in any pantry, providing a convenient and delicious option for those who appreciate the art of Italian cooking. Whether you're a seasoned chef or a home cook, you’ll appreciate the quality and authenticity that these tomatoes bring to your dishes.
